sources.title: GLM-OCR · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GLM-OCR is a multimodal OCR (Optical Character Recognition) model designed for complex document understanding from Z.ai. The model combines a CogViT visual encoder (pre-trained on large-scale image-text data), a lightweight cross-modal connector with efficient token downsampling, and a GLM-0.5B language decoder. sources.title: Best LLM for OCR (2026): GLM-OCR Wins at 94.62 — 7 Models Ranked
sources.snippet: Which AI model has the best OCR accuracy in 2026? On the OmniDocBench benchmark, specialized models lead: GLM-OCR scores 94.62 and PaddleOCR-VL hits 94.50. Among frontier LLMs, Gemini 3.1 Pro leads at 90.33, ahead of GPT-5.4 at roughly 85.8. The best choice depends on your use case — frontier LLMs handle reasoning alongside extraction, while specialized models maximize raw accuracy.
